svg.text: Longest Common Subsequence — filling the grid for "abcde" vs "ace"
dp[i][j] = LCS length of the first i letters of "abcde" and first j of "ace". Row
and column 0 are 0: against an empty string nothing matches.
Cell (a,a): the letters MATCH, so take the diagonal value and add 1 → 1. A match
always extends the best-so-far from the shorter prefixes.
Cell (b,c): letters DIFFER, so copy the better neighbor — from above (1) or the left
(1) → 1. Dropping one letter from either side must not lose progress.
Fill every cell the same way. The bottom-right corner holds the answer: 3 — the
